up: Retrieve all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5729625'. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). The compounds are linked to the document through compound_records: the document (docs) is joined to compound_records on doc_id, then compound_records.molregno links to molecule_dictionary.molregno, and molecule_dictionary.molregno links to compound_structures.molregno. Return the list of compounds with their ChEMBL IDs and SMILES.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729625';
